verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a design and animation tool, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows open-source runtime libraries for playing .riv files, and community comments note that content must still be built in the Rive Editor. Nothing documents self-hosting the core Editor product, and open-source runtimes are adjacent building blocks that earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
